8,641 reviews. 4.7 stars. And most tourists walk straight past MEO Kitchen.

This local Vietnamese restaurant on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is where Phu Quoc residents actually eat. The menu is straightforward, the portions are real, and the bill lands between $15-30 per person.

No flashy signage. No English-only menu boards. Just consistent food that keeps 8,000+ people coming back.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
